skills.label: Skills
skills.title: Skills
skills.description: A skill is a reusable set of instructions for a specific task, packaged for an AI app that supports skills. It may include templates, files or scripts.
skills.tileDescription: Reusable task instructions packaged for an AI app that supports skills.
skills.emptyDescription: Published skills will include their purpose, supported app, expected outcomes and setup steps.
useSteps: Open a skill and check its supported app, requirements and expected outcomes.
Follow that resource’s setup steps to add the skill to the supported app. The method depends on the app and the skill.
Use the skill for your task as its resource page describes, then review the result.
